Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application. After checking your CV against the requirements of this position, we will not move forward, because your CV does not show these required points: ML in production: 3 years of experience or more (training, testing, deployment, monitoring of real-time models); Proven experience with modern deep learning techniques and Gradient Boosting Trees; Excellent Python coding skills; Proficiency with ML libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, LightGBM, Scikit-learn); Experience with microservices architecture, cloud technologies, Docker and Kubernetes.

This decision was prepared with an automated system. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
